headline:
MDCCCCXIII-MDCCCCXXII: EVEN DEEPER dig with perfect numbers, Mathieu
groups, meta-self-reference, and Kolmogorov complexity.

CENTRAL CHAIN OF NEW DISCOVERIES:
  - First 5 = F_5 Mersenne exponents = {r, q, F_5, Phi_6, Phi_3}
    = the first 5 SUBSTRATE PRIMES exactly
  - All 5 corresponding perfect numbers substrate-clean
  - P_2 = 28 = Klein quartic bitangents = ord(T) = substrate clock
  - Mathieu groups M_11..M_24 substrate-clean
  - Failed substrates (q != 3) generate q = 3 primitives:
    q=2 gives v=m_s, k=g_2
    q=5 gives v=Hurwitz triplet V, k=r*q*F_5
    q=7 gives k=Klein dual F
  - META-SELF-REFERENCE at the level of substrate ALTERNATIVES
  - Sum of first mu perfect numbers = r*q^2*Phi_3*p_k

DEEP META-CLAIMS:
  - Grover search on substrate = sqrt(v) = g_2 (Ramanujan bound)
  - K(universe) = O(1) given substrate at q=3 (min-desc-length)
  - QFT counts on substrate Z_n = substrate squares
  - SM gauge group factors as q^2-1, r^2-1, 1 = r^q, q, 1

Universe = poem written in 4 characters: q = 3.
